I'm a young man and I don't take medication, but my study of mnemonics may be of help to you. Cynicaloldfart has a good suggestion; habit and organization will be the most important to you. You may also want to establish a memory aid, anything that will get your attention and serve as a reminder for what you want.

Example: You could hang a card on a door with a picture of a sun on one side and a moon on the other (or anything which will give you a clear meaning of before and after). Flip it to the sun when you walk by in the morning, and flip it to the moon after you've taken your medication.

You could also set a stamp or some small removable object on top of the next medication to be taken, when you're done for the day put it in the open to remind you the next day.

You could also use alarms or cellphone apps (cellphones and tablets have apps which let you set them to play certain music at certain times every day, along with a message).
